findings.message: Claim gate remains blocked, so UI correctly renders degraded / gate blocked instead of green.

Auditor noted that no independent runtime meter is attached. Packets and tests now expose negative_claim_basis and independent_runtime_meter_attached=false; endpoint tests verify model dry-run does not call run_prompt.
This contour intentionally proves only /v1/models and model dry-run by code-path guard; GPT/API inference and runtime token metering remain a next contour.
